race: Formula 1 MSC Cruises Grande Prêmio de São Paulo 2026

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Welcome in, Brazil is calling, and this weekend feels like the start of a brand new championship chapter, and we are ready.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: It really is, because the championship story is about to turn the page, and the data has us leaning hard into a very big weekend.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: And the news desk is buzzing, because this is the first page of the next championship battle, and everyone wants a piece of it.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Ferrari has a Hamilton and Leclerc problem, and that is the kind of story that makes radio shows fun, and we love a good fight.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Meanwhile, Antonelli says his two thousand twenty seven preparation starts now, which is a big statement from the leader.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Russell wants a deep, deep look in the mirror, and that is the best line of the whole news file, and it tells you the pressure.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Racing Bulls are keeping Permane as team principal, and stability is a quiet superpower in this sport, especially when the car is good.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Now, let us get to the picks that matter, because we are not just reading a list, we are building a race story for the weekend ahead.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: I have Kimi Antonelli first, because he is the championship leader with a dominant season and a solid Interlagos history, and that is the foundation.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: And Interlagos suits him, because his history there is a podium and a second, which is a perfect foundation for a confident weekend.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: So how do you beat that? You need a driver who has already won here, and you need Red Bull pace to be sharp enough to hurt Mercedes.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: That is Max Verstappen, because he has the best historical result at this circuit, with a win on the board and a record that shouts danger.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Three podiums in three races is a scary record, and his average of one point seven shows how consistent he has been at this track.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: But I have Lewis Hamilton third, because his recent form is firing, and Ferrari pace is still a serious weapon for the whole weekend.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: The risk is team chaos, and his history at this circuit is not kind, with an average of ninth and no podiums, so we keep him third.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Exactly, so it is a strong form pick with a risky badge, and that makes it the most interesting part of our top three debate.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: My deep cut is Pierre Gasly in tenth, because Alpine have top ten form and he has the best recent circuit history, and that is a real wildcard.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Low confidence, but that is the kind of pick that can steal a race, and Interlagos loves a surprise package when the race gets chaotic.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: I like that, because a tenth place finish can become a podium if the strategy and chaos all line up in the right order.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Before the list, let us touch the rest of our top ten, because the middle of the field is where the fun lives.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Charles Leclerc is fourth for us, because he is a consistent podium contender with a strong race car and a big weekend ahead.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: George Russell is fifth, because Mercedes pace is there, and his Baku win gives us a big confidence boost for Sunday.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Lando Norris is sixth, Isack Hadjar is seventh, and Liam Lawson is eighth, because points are the whole game this weekend.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Oscar Piastri is ninth, because McLaren strength and recent top five results make him a quiet threat all weekend long.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: So the full top ten, in order, is Kimi Antonelli, Max Verstappen, Lewis Hamilton, Charles Leclerc, George Russell, Lando Norris, Isack Hadjar, Liam Lawson, Oscar Piastri, Pierre Gasly.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: That is your Brazil weekend, and we cannot wait to see who takes the lead at the first corner.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Enjoy the race, and we will be right here when the lights go out, because this is where the next story starts.
